relationships.rationale: Salesforce Sales Cloud is the deployed CRM for sales, service, and case management.
Oracle Utilities Customer Self Service provides the customer-facing digital experience portal.
The customer mobile app is built and maintained on the OutSystems low-code platform.
Genesys Cloud CX provides voice, chat, and email routing with an agent desktop.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud runs campaign management and customer journeys.
IBM Maximo Application Suite is the asset register and work-order management system.
Oracle Field Service schedules and dispatches field crews.
PTC ThingWorx is the industrial IoT platform being trialled for edge telemetry.
ION Endur is the energy trading and risk management system of record.
LSEG Workspace supplies wholesale price feeds and forward curves.
Murex MX.3 provides VaR, stress testing, and credit risk analytics for the trading book.
GE Vernova PowerOn Advantage operates the transmission network in real time.
Siemens Spectrum Power operates the transmission network in real time.
Oracle Utilities Network Management System handles outage prediction, dispatch, and customer communication.
Esri ArcGIS Utility Network is the spatial register of network assets and connectivity.
Oracle Utilities Customer Care & Billing holds the customer, account, and contract master plus billing engine.
Oracle Utilities Revenue Management and Billing performs tariff modelling, pricing, and rating.
Oracle Utilities Meter Data Management validates, estimates, and stores meter reads.
Itron Enterprise Edition is the head-end system for smart-meter communications.
Workiva produces compliance, statutory, and regulatory reports.
Persefoni is being trialled for Scope 1/2/3 emissions data capture and calculation.
Diligent ESG is being trialled for ESG disclosure aggregation and reporting.
Databricks Lakehouse Platform provides unified storage and compute for data products.
Oracle Enterprise Data Management Cloud manages master data for customers, assets, and reference data.
Oracle Analytics Cloud provides self-service analytics, dashboards, and reporting.
Amazon SageMaker is the model training and deployment platform being trialled for ML workloads.
Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP covers finance, procurement, and cost management.
Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM covers core HR, payroll, talent, and learning.
ServiceNow ITSM handles incident, problem, change, and asset management for IT.
Microsoft 365 provides email, messaging, documents, and meetings for the workforce.
Apigee is the managed gateway for inter-system API traffic.
Confluent Platform is the shared event-driven messaging backbone.
Oracle Integration Cloud runs low-code orchestrations and SaaS integrations.

activity.notes: Reviewed and refined during the 2026-Q1 architecture cycle.
